tablet.notes:
Delete on a Not sent text now really deletes it (on the phone too), and it stays in the trash instead of coming back.
Also since build 617: Settings in sections, Clear in the crash log clears the phone's crashes too, resending a failed text replaces it, Sending... until the carrier answers, pictures on every tablet.

tablet-regular.notes:
Hold a message: the whole screen goes soft, emoji reactions sit above it and a card of actions below (Forward, Copy, Delete, Select more, Info), like Google Messages. Select more and the Details page match too.
The keyboard closes after you send and when you swipe through the messages. The voice recorder is much smaller. The tablet icon on messages another tablet sent no longer goes missing.
Fixed a crash when opening a video that had been downloaded ahead.
Since the last update: bubbles stop at about three quarters of the width.

messageplus.notes:
A text that did not go out can now be deleted from the tablet: it is deleted on the phone too and stays in the trash (before, it came back).
Also since build 128: Sending... until the carrier answers, resend replaces the failed text, calls in batches, the default texting app shown on the tablet, a new sync replaces the old one, pictures for every tablet, new groups get their own group, blocking and muting shared with the tablet.

messageplus_previous.notes:
A text from the tablet shows Sending... until the carrier answers, then Sent or Not sent (no more Sent for a moment before Not sent).
Calls are sent to the tablet in batches (much lighter on the phone). The tablet and the dashboard now show whether Message+ is the default texting app. A sync is not run again within 10 minutes of the last one.
Also since build 128: a new sync replaces the old one, pictures stay available for every tablet, new groups get their own group, no doubled messages, blocking and muting shared with the tablet.

tablet2.notes:
Fixes messages showing twice after the phone's history sync, and makes opening the app with a large message history much faster (the cleanup of those copies no longer scans every message again and again).
Also in this copy: the Performance log (Settings > Performance log), and group texts from a new group start their own group.
